    01 Plausibility

    It need not be too implausible that Paul received Jesus information this way. After all…

    • …Paul was well-connected to the Jerusalem church. [Forthcoming]
    • …Paul believed his all teachings matched the Jerusalem church’s. [Forthcoming]
    Argument path
      Did Paul get info on Jesus from the Jerusalem church?
      Yes
      Yes Reasons affirming the proposition Did Paul get info on Jesus from the Jerusalem church?

      • Examples exist of Jesus information he received from them

        Examples exist where he received Jesus information from them.

        After all,…

        • …Paul received a ton from Peter during his Gal 1:18 visit[?]
        • …Paul received Jesus info from them via group memories (“traditions”)
             * …Paul relays “received” creedal statements that they formulated on Jesus[?]
               * …the 1 Cor 7:10 creed Paul relays originated from Jerusalem.
               * …the 1 Cor 11:23-25 creed Paul relays originated from Jerusalem.
               * …the 1 Cor 15:3-7 creed Paul relays originated from Jerusalem.

      • Pauls teachings matched the Jerusalem church’s

        Pauls teachings matched the Jerusalem church’s

        After all,…

        • …examples abound…
             * …on history. [Forthcoming]
             * …on doctrine/theology. [Forthcoming]

        This is relevant because it’s not a coincidence. (Paul was in contact with the church and it’s the most plausible source from which Paul would accept such information.)

      • Paul aimed to know Jesus biography

        After all,…

        • Examples abound of Jesus biography Paul wanted to know.
        • Paul had clear reason to want to know Jesus biography.
        • Paul visited Jerusalem/Peter precisely to know it (15 days).

        This is relevant because:

        • Paul saw the Jerusalem church as experts on Jesus biography. [Forthcoming]
        • Their knowledge was easily accessible to him. [Forthcoming]

      • Paul knew a lot of Jesus’s biography

        Paul knew a lot of Jesus’s biography.

        • Paul's letters report and allude to much known Jesus biography.
        • Paul got tons of biography from visiting Jerusalem.
        • Paul's argument in Galatians assumes a narrative substructure.

        This is relevant because the Jerusalem church is the most plausible source of Paul’s knowledge.

        But no...

        • In 2 Cor 5:16 Paul says we don't know Jesus “according to flesh”
        • Examples exist of places we’d expect Paul to use Jesus biography. [Forthcoming]
